_comment: Corrections to data/ (never edited by hand): numbers the 5e-database snapshot has wrong against the SRD 5.1's own text and tables. The loader applies them over the class table rows (corrections) and over a creature's Multiattack count (creature_corrections), and refuses an unknown class, creature, field or level.

corrections.source: SRD 5.1, Warlock table, Invocations Known: 1 none, 2-4 two, 5-6 three, 7-8 four, 9-11 five, 12-14 six, 15-17 seven, 18-20 eight (the snapshot has 3 at level 4 and 4 at level 6)

creature_corrections.source: SRD 5.1, Brown Bear, Multiattack: one with its bite and one with its claws (the snapshot reads Bite as an ability and counts 1)
SRD 5.1, Gibbering Mouther, Multiattack: one bite attack, and Blinding Spittle is a saving throw, not an attack (the snapshot counts 2)
SRD 5.1, Shambling Mound, Multiattack: two slam attacks; Engulf is not an attack (the snapshot counts 3)
SRD 5.1, Veteran, Multiattack: two longsword attacks and, with a shortsword drawn, one shortsword attack (the snapshot counts 2 shortsword attacks, 4 in all)
